platform: Women's open-source career platform (ideas via calls, voice notes, WhatsApp)

riskRegister.threat: Contributor's phone number or address leaks (doxxing)
riskRegister.control: No phone numbers, emails or ID numbers in code, logs or exports

riskRegister.threat: Voice notes carry location or identity metadata
riskRegister.control: Strip metadata and never commit raw media to repositories

riskRegister.threat: API keys leak and attackers read submissions
riskRegister.control: No secrets committed; keys in a secret manager
HTTPS everywhere with HSTS and valid certificates

riskRegister.threat: Clickjacking or script injection on the web app
riskRegister.control: CSP, frame protection and nosniff headers

riskRegister.threat: AI tool server is unreachable or misconfigured
riskRegister.control: MCP handshake and tool listing pass from the monitor

riskRegister.threat: Account takeover through SIM swap or OTP interception
riskRegister.control: Offer app-based 2FA or passkeys, not SMS only

riskRegister.threat: Harassment or stalking through public contributor profiles
riskRegister.control: Private-by-default profiles, block and report, moderation queue

riskRegister.threat: Recordings used without consent or kept too long
riskRegister.control: Explicit consent prompt and a written retention limit

riskRegister.threat: Impersonation of the platform to phish contributors
riskRegister.control: Verified WhatsApp Business number; published official contact list
